plan.intent: Keep the verified event-driven brightness/sound refresh. Add a native AppKit NSMenu on Apple-icon click, with About This Mac, System Settings, App Store, System Information, Force Quit chooser, Sleep, confirmation-based Restart/Shut Down/Log Out and Lock Screen when supported. Hover highlights Apple but does not open it. Fixed trusted action mappings, no arbitrary shell or global key emulation. Current-app File/View menus remain AX-based. The added menu may require one final native rebuild; do not weaken signing identity or bypass OS consent. Test native action mappings without invoking session/power actions, inspect the actual menu and verify safe About/Settings launches; preserve/reverify the keyboard-refresh proof and publish to main.
